children.name: Pseudolappula occultata
children.description: Description. Annual herbs. Stems erect, 15 - 40 cm tall, frequently branched from base or above middle, with appressed or semi-appressed white hairs. Basal leaves oblong with obvious petiole, 2 - 3 cm long, 5 - 8 mm wide; cauline leaves sessile, oblong to lanceolate, 2 - 4 cm long, 4 - 9 mm wide, with spreading hairs, hairs discoid at base. Inflorescences to 10 - 15 cm in fruit; bracts small, narrowly ovate to linear. Pedicels erect, the lower 5 - 6 mm long. Calyx lobes linear, erect, 2 mm long,
